Platform operator: [name and legal form]. Registered office: [address]. Represented by: [authorised representatives]. Register entry: [register court and number]. VAT identification number: [VAT ID]. Contact: [email address], [phone number].

The platform operator does not provide the counselling. The platform carries several counselling services and specialist areas; they are run by independent carriers and their counselling centres. platform.dataprotection:
You are not signed in with a counselling centre yet — this note is about the platform itself.

Placeholder: this is not the published privacy policy yet. It stands here until the platform operator has entered their details.

Controller for the platform: [name, legal form, address]. Data protection officer: [name, contact]. Supervisory authority: [name and address].

Signing in processes only what signing in needs. Your messages are end-to-end encrypted: they become readable only on your device and at your counselling centre. The platform operator cannot technically read counselling content.

The platform carries several counselling services and specialist areas. The counselling is provided by independent carriers and their counselling centres; they process the data of your counselling largely themselves and on their own responsibility. The platform operator provides and runs the technology and forwards — mediates — your enquiry. Where both decide on purposes and means together, they do so as joint controllers; which duty is met by whom is set out in the agreement between platform operator and carrier.

What your counselling centre processes beyond that is set out in its own privacy policy. You see it before you write your first message.

Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, objection, and complaint to the supervisory authority. Please use [contact route for data subject requests].

0.intro:
To explain the individual functions, we have prepared a short tour for you.

They can cancel it at any time or start it again in their profile.
0.title: Tour

1.intro:
Here you will find an overview of all open requests that are not yet assigned to a consultant. Your entire team has access to this overview.

The oldest requests are at the top, the newest at the bottom, to make it easier for you to find the ones you received first.

The moment you click on "Accept request", the request will be immediately moved to your "My consultations" section and the other consultants will not see it anymore.
1.title: Initial inquiries

3.intro:
In this section you will find all the requests that you have accepted.

The message history that was last edited is at the top. If the person seeking advice is currently online in the waiting room, you will see the label "Active" right next to the name.
3.title: My consultations

4.intro:
To avoid being distracted by conversations that are not active, you can archive some of the conversations.

They will then not be deleted, but only moved to the "Archive" tab.

Every time you or the advice seeker write something in an archived conversation, that message history is put back into the advice seeker list.
4.title: Archive

6.intro: In the profile area you can manage personal and public information, enable out-of-office messaging during your vacation, change your password and use many other features (like setting up 2-factor authentication).
6.title: Profile

greeting.body: Thank you for getting in touch. Your message has reached us.

whoReadsAlong.headline: Who reads your message
whoReadsAlong.body: Only the trained staff of the responsible counselling centre read your message. Everyone there is bound by confidentiality.

responseDeadline.headline: When you will get a reply
responseDeadline.body: You will receive a reply from a suitable contact person within {{deadlineDays}} working days.

modalityNote.body: The counselling takes place in writing, in this protected area. You can keep writing at any time.

noPersonalData.headline: Please do not send personal data
noPersonalData.body: Please do not send us your full name, your address or your phone number. We do not need any of that for the counselling.

emergencyNumbers.headline: If it cannot wait
emergencyNumbers.body: In an acute emergency you can reach Telefonseelsorge around the clock on 0800 111 0 111 or 0800 111 0 222, and the emergency services on 112.

dataProtection.body: How we handle your data is set out in the privacy policy.

emailNotification.headline: Notification by e-mail
emailNotification.body: You may leave an e-mail address, entirely voluntarily. We will then let you know as soon as a reply is there. The content of the counselling never appears in that e-mail.

accountProtection.headline: Your access, additionally protected
accountProtection.body: You can secure your access with a second factor, so that nobody else can get in.

closing.body: See you soon — we will get back to you.

saveCredentials.headline: Keep hold of your access
saveCredentials.body: Without your login name you will not be able to return to this conversation later. Keep it somewhere safe — a password manager is best.
saveCredentials.sharedDevice: If other people use this device, better not to save your login name here — write it down somewhere safe instead.
saveCredentials.copyFailed: Copying failed. Please select the login name and copy it by hand.

displayName.headline: Your displayed name
displayName.body: In the conversation you appear under a randomly generated name. You can roll a new one at any time.

mailCounselling.title: Mail counselling
mailCounselling.summary: What has changed in mail counselling — from the first enquiry to the archive.

whatsNew.title: What is new?
whatsNew.intro: You already know mail counselling from the previous platform. This short tour shows you where your familiar workflows live now — and what is genuinely new.

enquiries.title: Initial enquiries
enquiries.intro: New enquiries arrive in a shared list, as before — it now lives here. Until someone accepts, every consultant of your counselling centre sees the open enquiry.

accepting.title: Accepting & first response
accepting.intro: With “Accept” you take an enquiry into your consultations. New: advice seekers automatically receive a first response with the most important information right after their first message — you can start without time pressure.

mySessions.title: My consultations
mySessions.intro: Your accepted consultations live here — sorted by the most recent message, just as you are used to.

composer.title: Writing — with new options
composer.intro: New compared to the previous platform: you can reply in threads, record voice messages and attach files directly.

archive.title: Archive
archive.intro: Finished consultations move to the archive as before — it now lives in this tab.
